item.title: Mike Adams, MD
item.dc:creator: cmsmasters
item.content:encoded:
I enjoy getting to know my patients and building meaningful relationships. I understand that each person is unique and that they have diverse cultural backgrounds, so I strive to actively listen and empower them to be an advocate for the health and wellness goals that are important to them. I’m dedicated to providing compassionate and individualized care by providing patient education and practicing evidence-based medicine. I’m passionate about practicing preventive medicine and helping my patients manage acute and chronic health conditions, mental health, and overall well-being.

I find joy by doing almost any outdoor activity, including hiking, running, and exploring with our furbabies. I enjoy spending time with family and friends. I also strive to live mindfully and intentionally by creating uplifting routines and relaxing rituals.

About Us

Why We are the Best Clinic?

World-class rehabilitation solutions and individualized recovery plans, from acute care to ongoing outpatient treatment and beyond.

Welcome to Renew Medical

Welcome to Our Clinic, where your health and well-being are our top priority. Our team of experienced physicians, nurses, and healthcare professionals is dedicated to delivering personalized medical services tailored to meet your unique needs.

Our Story

We are proud to be an integral part of the community we serve. Through outreach programs, health education seminars, and partnerships with local organizations, we aim to promote a healthier community and provide resources to those in need.
Meet our team

Our Professional Team

View All Doctors

AREAS OF SPECIALTY

We can help you with the following conditions:

What Our Patients Say

More than 250 five-star reviews on Google 5/5

Ava D. 5/5

item.title: Author Page
item.dc:creator: cmsmasters
item.content:encoded:
Home/No breadcrumbs

Anna Rue

The European languages are members of the same family. Their separate existence is a myth. For science, music, sport, etc, Europe uses the same vocabulary. The languages only differ in their grammar, their pronunciation and their most common words. To achieve this, it would be necessary to have uniform grammar, pronunciation.

Everyone realizes why a new common language would be desirable: one could refuse to pay expensive translators. To achieve this, it would be necessary to have uniform grammar, pronunciation.

compassionate rehabilitative care

Your Journey to Recovery Starts Here

Our Services

I want to...

  • Access Medical Records
  • Pay a Bill
  • Make an Appointment
  • Refer a Patient
  • Donate
  • Volunteer
Welcome to renew medical
We’re here to provide you with world-class rehabilitation solutions and individualized recovery plans, from acute care to ongoing outpatient treatment and beyond.

Comprehensive Medical Care and Neurorehabilitation

We specialize in providing inpatient rehabilitation for patients who require round-the-clock hospital care. We use personalized treatments to get you back to living your life.
  • Three hours of therapy, five days per week;
  • 24/7 nursing care, including nurses who specialize in rehabilitation;
  • Frequent visits from a physician.
Meet Our Team

Why people choose us

Cutting-Edge Physical Therapy Treatments

  • Acute Inpatient Care Physicians, physical therapists, occupational therapists, speech therapists, nurses guide patients to reach their maximum potential.
  • Outpatient Care From vision rehabilitation to neuropsychology services, we can prescribe the programs that will get you back to your maximum potential. 
  • Community Reintegration Even when a patient makes tremendous progress after a traumatic incident, there still can be challenges going back to day-to-day living.
  • Research & Expertise Our patients’ lives have been turned upside down, and that drives us to always seek new and progressive treatment options.
Find Out More

33

Years of quality service

AREAS OF SPECIALTY

We can help you with the following conditions:

Stroke Rehabilitation
Stroke Rehabilitation
Recovering ability, mobility amd more
Amputee
Rehabilitation
Amputee
Rehabilitation
Overcoming the challenges of limb loss
Neurologic Rehabilitation
Neurologic Rehabilitation
Optimizing your individual abilities
Brain Injuries
Brain Injuries
Restoring the skills to rebuild your life
Spinal Cord Injuries
Spinal Cord Injuries
Discovering the path to independence
Medically Complex Rehabilitation
Medically Complex Rehabilitation
Finding solutions to complex needs
Orthopedic Rehabilitation
Orthopedic Rehabilitation
Regaining function and movement
Outpatient Rehabilitation
Outpatient Rehabilitation
Continuing to build strenght and skills View All Services

Our goal is to get you back home

Patient-centered care
Patient-centred care is about treating a person receiving healthcare with dignity and respect and involving them in all decisions about their health. This type of care is also called ‘person-centred care’. It is an approach that is linked to a person’s healthcare rights.
Family-friendly environment
Aside from the treatment program, an overlooked aspect of treatment is the environment. Many people do not realize how big a factor this is for those who want to recover.
Supportive peer mentorship community

Mentorship and peer support are pivotal in creating environments that nurture personal and collective growth and success, making each feel connected and valued.

Better Rehabilitation Starts Here

item.content:encoded:
Empowering Recovery on Your Journey to Wellness

World-class rehabilitation solutions and individualized recovery plans, from acute care to ongoing outpatient treatment and beyond. Refer a Patient
  • Give Us a Call: + 0800 2336 7811

Welcome to
Renew Medical!

Our clinic offers high-quality, professional services designed to help individuals with sport or work-related injuries, prolonged pain of virtually any part of the body. Our team is dedicated to offering expertise and care needed to tackle any issue.

Helping Since 2002

Our clinic provides high-quality, hands-on and one-on-one treatments. View Details

Trusted by Thousands

We offer high quality services. Check out patients’ testimonials! View Details

Covered by Insurance

Majority of our services are covered by insurance. Check out our FAQ. View Details

Professional Staff

A physical therapist can help you recover & maintain mobility. Licensed Therapists.

View Details

Why Choose Us

Most Popular Issues & Diagnoses That We Treat

To discuss your specific diagnosis or issues, please contact the location nearest you to speak to one of our highly trained therapists.

  • Back and neck pain
  • Osteoarthritis
  • Soft tissue injuries
  • Foot and heel disorders
  • Post-surgical rehab
  • Sports rehab
  • Neuromuscular disorders
  • ...and much more!
View All Services

AREAS OF SPECIALTY

We can help you with the following conditions:

Our goal is to get you back home

Patient-centered care
Patient-centred care is about treating a person receiving healthcare with dignity and respect and involving them in all decisions about their health. This type of care is also called ‘person-centred care’. It is an approach that is linked to a person’s healthcare rights.
Family-friendly environment
Aside from the treatment program, an overlooked aspect of treatment is the environment. Many people do not realize how big a factor this is for those who want to recover.
Supportive peer mentorship community
Mentorship and peer support are pivotal in creating environments that nurture personal and collective growth, learning, and success, making each feel connected and valued.

We accept all major insurance plans

Please call us at

415-523-6317

and we’ll help you out.

meet our doctors

Dedicated Team of Experts

View All Doctors

Average Cost of
Rehabilitation Programs

The cost of rehabilitation programs can vary significantly depending on several factors. Understanding these factors is essential for individuals seeking rehabilitation services.

Inpatient Rehabilitation Programs

Frequently Asked Questions

Can't find what you're looking for? Contact Us

What will I be charged for services rendered?

The charge for services included on your bill is based on many factors that vary from hospital to hospital, including the costs of buying medications, equipment and other supplies; paying highly-trained healthcare workers; purchasing up-to-date medical technology; and operations and maintenance costs.

How much will I have to pay?

The best way for patients to determine their out-of-pocket costs in advance of obtaining services is to contact their insurer, whether that is a commercial health insurance company, Medicare or a state Medicaid program (for non covered services).

When is payment expected?

With the exception of co-payment amounts, REHAB expects payment within 30 days of the billing date shown on your statement.

What if I am having difficulty with payments or am unable to make payment in full?

Patients who are challenged with payments or cannot pay their bill in full should contact a Patient Financial Services representative at (808) 544-3340 to discuss available payment options.

I have insurance, why am I being billed?

Depending on the insurance company and plan you have, cost sharing is based on plan benefits. It is common for patients to pay a portion which may be for a co-insurance payment, deductible or a charge not covered by your insurance provider.

item.title: Home Three
item.dc:creator: cmsmasters
item.content:encoded:
Empowering Recovery on Your Journey to Wellness

World-class rehabilitation solutions and individualized recovery plans, from acute care to ongoing outpatient treatment and beyond. Refer a Patient
  • Give Us a Call: + 0800 2336 7811

Become a Patient

Your life is waiting. Fast, long-lasting relief is nearby.

Welcome to renew medical

Your Journey to Recovery Starts Here

We specialize in providing inpatient rehabilitation for patients who require round-the-clock hospital care. We use personalized treatments to get you back to living your life. More About Us

Helping Since 2002

Our clinic provides high-quality, hands-on and one-on-one treatments. About Us

Trusted by Thousands

We offer high quality services. Check out patients’ testimonials! View Reviews

Covered by Insurance

Majority of our services are covered by insurance. Check out our FAQ. Read More

Professional Staff

A physical therapist can help you recover & maintain mobility. Licensed Therapists. Our Team

Comprehensive Medical Care and Neurorehabilitation

We specialize in providing inpatient rehabilitation for patients who require round-the-clock hospital care. We use personalized treatments to get you back to living your life.
  • Three hours of therapy five days per week;
  • 24/7 nursing care including nurses who specialize in rehabilitation;
  • Licensed therapists and frequent visits from a physician.
Our Services

2

Hospital locations
World-class rehabilitation solutions and individualized recovery plans.

2,100

Licensed nurses and therapists
Our experienced team strives to provide a positive, stress-free experience.

80

Rehabilitation beds
We specialize in providing inpatient rehabilitation for patients.

7,000+

Lives impacted every year
Physicians, physical therapists, nurses guide patients to reach their maximum potential.

Rehabilitation Programs

We provide you with exceptional specialty healthcare. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Uzewz9oMOe4

Patients love Renew Medical

More than 250 five-star reviews on Google 5/5

The best dental care I have ever experienced! Professional and friendly staff made me feel like family… would highly recommend to anyone!!!

Cynthia, Stroke Rehabilitation 5/5

Rehabilitation was harder than I expected, but I’m grateful to resume my active lifestyle once again. I would not have made it, if it weren’t for my rehab team.

Cynthia, Stroke Rehabilitation 5/5

This is a wonderful dental office with very professional and friendly staff and up to date technology. They took me at a very short notice when I needed emergency dental work, they were so nice and accommodating.

David, Spinal Cord Injury 5/5

meet our doctors

Dedicated Team of Experts & Medical Professionals

Our team is dedicated to offering expertise and care needed to tackle any issue. Our physical therapists can help you recover & maintain mobility. Meet the Team

Awards & recognition

Excellence Recognized Both Nationally and Locally

View More

Frequently Asked Questions

Can't find what you're looking for? Contact Us

What will I be charged for services rendered?

The charge for services included on your bill is based on many factors that vary from hospital to hospital, including the costs of buying medications, equipment and other supplies; paying highly-trained healthcare workers; purchasing up-to-date medical technology; and operations and maintenance costs.

How much will I have to pay?

The best way for patients to determine their out-of-pocket costs in advance of obtaining services is to contact their insurer, whether that is a commercial health insurance company, Medicare or a state Medicaid program (for non covered services).

When is payment expected?

With the exception of co-payment amounts, REHAB expects payment within 30 days of the billing date shown on your statement.

What if I am having difficulty with payments or am unable to make payment in full?

Patients who are challenged with payments or cannot pay their bill in full should contact a Patient Financial Services representative at (808) 544-3340 to discuss available payment options.

I have insurance, why am I being billed?

Depending on the insurance company and plan you have, cost sharing is based on plan benefits. It is common for patients to pay a portion which may be for a co-insurance payment, deductible or a charge not covered by your insurance provider.

item.title: Amenities
item.dc:creator: cmsmasters
item.content:encoded:
Our Amenities

Life Needn't Come to a Standstill Because You're in Rehab

Main Lobby

  • Welcome center for entire campus
  • Complimentary valet parking and wayfinding escorts
  • Registration staff or mobile check-in for outpatient appointments
  • Comfortable waiting area for outpatient appointments

Second Floor

  • Two patient dining areas
  • Three fireplaces
  • Reflective Day Space
  • Hair salon
  • Windowed seating areas with comfortable benches and great city views

Third Floor

  • Gardens around campus include the Courtyard Garden
  • The gardens provide healing spaces for patients and visitors
  • Two social spaces with comfortable seating, computers, TVs, coffee machines
  • Rooftop terrace, accessible on third floor
Schedule your visit online

Take the next step and schedule an appointment today

item.title: Three Years Post Injury: Persistence and Progress
item.dc:creator: cmsmasters
item.content:encoded:
For science, music, sport, etc, Europe uses the same vocabulary. The languages only differ in their grammar, their pronunciation and their most common words. Everyone realizes why a new common language would be desirable: one could refuse to pay expensive translators. To achieve this, it would be necessary to have uniform grammar, pronunciation and more common words. Their separate existence is a myth.

The injury or lack thereof…

For science, music, sport, etc, Europe uses the same vocabulary. The languages only differ in their grammar, their pronunciation and their most common words. Everyone realizes why a new common language would be desirable: one could refuse to pay expensive translators. To achieve this, it would be necessary to have uniform grammar, pronunciation and more common words. Their separate existence is a myth.

An example…

The European languages are members of the same family. Their separate existence is a myth. For science, music, sport, etc, Europe uses the same vocabulary. The languages only differ in their grammar, their pronunciation and their most common words. Everyone realizes why a new common language would be desirable: one could refuse to pay expensive translators. The European languages are members of the same family. Their separate existence is a myth. For science, music, sport, etc, Europe uses the same vocabulary. The languages only differ in their grammar, their pronunciation and their most common words.

To an English person, it will seem like simplified English, as a skeptical Cambridge friend of mine told me what Occidental is. The European languages are members of the same family. Their separate existence is a myth. For science, music, sport, etc, Europe uses the same vocabulary. The languages only differ in their grammar, their pronunciation and their most common words. Everyone realizes why a new common language would be desirable: one could refuse to pay expensive translators. To achieve this, it would be necessary. To an English person, it will seem like simplified English, as a skeptical Cambridge friend of mine told me what Occidental is. The European languages are members of the same family. Their separate existence is a myth. For science, music, sport.

A recap…

The European languages are members of the same family. Their separate existence is a myth. For science, music, sport, etc, Europe uses the same vocabulary. The languages only differ in their grammar, their pronunciation and their most common words.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ntx1Nn5C4nI

My philosophy

The languages only differ in their grammar, their pronunciation and their most common words. Everyone realizes why a new common language would be desirable: one could refuse to pay expensive translators. To achieve this, it would be necessary to have uniform grammar, pronunciation and more common words. If several languages coalesce. The European languages are members of the same family.

The new common language will be more simple and regular than the existing European languages. It will be as simple as Occidental; in fact, it will be Occidental. To an English person, it will seem like simplified English, as a skeptical Cambridge friend of mine told.

These particular types of injuries can be a challenge to diagnose because determining cause and effect becomes more difficult. It’s not like you fell, twisted your knee and then developed pain. That would rule in one or two particular structures.

In Summary…

The new common language will be more simple and regular than the existing European languages. It will be as simple as Occidental; in fact, it will be Occidental. To an English person, it will seem like simplified English, as a skeptical Cambridge friend of mine told me. The European languages are members of the same family. Their separate existence is a myth. To an English person, it will seem like simplified English, as a skeptical Cambridge friend of mine told me.

item.title: Successful Transitional Rehab: More Than Just Exercise

item.content:encoded:
If several languages coalesce, the grammar of the resulting language is more simple and regular than that of the individual languages. The new common language will be more simple and regular than the existing European languages. Europe uses the same vocabulary.

Patients who have experienced a serious injury, illness, or joint replacement surgery often require rehabilitation services that include physical and occupational therapies.

John Collins

The Three “R’s” of Successful Rehabilitation

The new common language will be more simple and regular than the existing European languages. Europe uses the same vocabulary.
  • The European languages are members of the same family. Their separate existence is a myth. For science, music, sport, etc.
  • Europe uses the same vocabulary.
  • The languages only differ in their grammar, their pronunciation and their most common words. The European languages are members of the same family.
If several languages coalesce, the grammar of the resulting language is more simple and regular than that of the individual languages. The new common language will be more simple and regular than the existing European languages. Europe uses the same vocabulary.

Regain Strength

The languages only differ in their grammar, their pronunciation and their most common words. Everyone realizes why a new common language would be desirable: one could refuse to pay expensive translators.
  • To achieve this, it would be necessary to have uniform grammar, pronunciation and more common words.
  • If several languages coalesce, the grammar of the resulting language is more simple and regular than that of the individual languages.
The new common language will be more simple and regular than the existing European languages. It will be as simple as Occidental.

Relax

To achieve this, it would be necessary to have uniform grammar, pronunciation and more common words. If several languages coalesce, the grammar of the resulting language is more simple and regular than that of the individual languages.

item.title: What is Respite Care and Why is it Important?
item.dc:creator: cmsmasters
item.content:encoded:
The new common language will be more simple and regular than the existing European languages. It will be as simple as Occidental; in fact, it will be Occidental. To an English person, it will seem like simplified English, as a skeptical Cambridge friend of mine told me what Occidental is. The European languages are members of the same family. Their separate existence is a myth. For science, music, sport, etc, Europe uses the same vocabulary.

What is respite care?

The new common language will be more simple and regular than the existing European languages. It will be as simple as Occidental; in fact, it will be Occidental. To an English person, it will seem like simplified English, as a skeptical Cambridge friend of mine told me what Occidental.

The new common language will be more simple and regular than the existing European languages. It will be as simple as Occidental; in fact, it will be Occidental. To an English person, it will seem like simplified English, as a skeptical Cambridge friend of mine told me what Occidental is. The European languages are members of the same family. Their separate existence is a myth. For science, music, sport, etc, Europe uses the same vocabulary. The languages only differ in their grammar, their pronunciation and their most common words. Everyone realizes why a new common language would be desirable: one could refuse to pay expensive translators. To achieve this, it would be necessary to have uniform grammar, pronunciation and more common words. The European languages are members of the same. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GQYa0Ks0a6A

Why is respite care important?

  • Reducing waste is an important part of mindful consumption.
  • Reusing and repurposing items is another way to practice mindful consumption.
  • Recycling is a key component of mindful consumption.
  • Mindful shopping is about making informed choices when it comes to purchasing new items.

What benefits does respite care offer the caregiver?

Everyone realizes why a new common language would be desirable: one could refuse to pay expensive translators. To achieve this, it would be necessary to have uniform grammar, pronunciation and more common words.

What is caregiver burnout?

item.title: Rolling Walker
item.dc:creator: cmsmasters
item.content:encoded: Far far away, behind the word mountains, far from the countries Vokalia and Consonantia, there live the blind texts. Separated they live in Bookmarksgrove right at the coast of the Semantics, a large language ocean. A small river named Duden flows by their place and supplies it with the necessary regelialia. It is a paradisematic country, in which roasted parts of sentences fly into your mouth. Even the all-powerful Pointing has no control about the blind texts it is an almost unorthographic life.
item.excerpt:encoded: Designed for safety and convenience, this rolling walker features push-button mechanisms that may be operated by fingers, palms, or even the side of the hand.

wp:comment.wp:comment_content: I definitely recommend it to everyone. Let\'s celebrate with our entire homeland!!!

item.title: Metal Hand Gripper
item.dc:creator: cmsmasters
item.excerpt:encoded: Gripper hand exercises are beneficial for enhancing the strength and endurance of the fingers, wrist, brachioradialis, deltoid, biceps, and promoting muscle development. Great rehabilitation tools for people suffering from arthritis, tendonitis, carpal tunnel, hand injuries, and recovering from tendon surgery.

wp:comment.wp:comment_content: A gorgeous brush.

item.title: Prosthetic Training
item.dc:creator: cmsmasters
item.content:encoded:
About Prosthetic Training Services

I enjoy getting to know my patients and building meaningful relationships. I understand that each person is unique and that they have diverse cultural backgrounds, so I strive to actively listen and empower them to be an advocate for the health and wellness goals that are important to them. I’m dedicated to providing compassionate and individualized care by providing patient education and practicing evidence-based medicine. I’m passionate about practicing preventive medicine and helping my patients manage acute and chronic health conditions, mental health.

I find joy by doing almost any outdoor activity, including hiking, running, and exploring with our furbabies. I enjoy spending time with family and friends. I also strive to live mindfully and intentionally by creating uplifting routines and relaxing rituals.

item.title: Outpatient Rehabilitation
item.dc:creator: cmsmasters
item.content:encoded:
About Outpatient Rehabilitation Services

I enjoy getting to know my patients and building meaningful relationships. I understand that each person is unique and that they have diverse cultural backgrounds, so I strive to actively listen and empower them to be an advocate for the health and wellness goals that are important to them. I’m dedicated to providing compassionate and individualized care by providing patient education and practicing evidence-based medicine. I’m passionate about practicing preventive medicine and helping my patients manage acute and chronic health conditions, mental health.

I find joy by doing almost any outdoor activity, including hiking, running, and exploring with our furbabies. I enjoy spending time with family and friends. I also strive to live mindfully and intentionally by creating uplifting routines and relaxing rituals.

Frequently Asked Questions

About Medically Complex Rehabilitation Services

I enjoy getting to know my patients and building meaningful relationships. I understand that each person is unique and that they have diverse cultural backgrounds, so I strive to actively listen and empower them to be an advocate for the health and wellness goals that are important to them. I’m dedicated to providing compassionate and individualized care by providing patient education and practicing evidence-based medicine. I’m passionate about practicing preventive medicine and helping my patients manage acute and chronic health conditions, mental health.

item.title: Brain Injuries
item.dc:creator: cmsmasters
item.content:encoded:
About Brain Injuries Services

I enjoy getting to know my patients and building meaningful relationships. I understand that each person is unique and that they have diverse cultural backgrounds, so I strive to actively listen and empower them to be an advocate for the health and wellness goals that are important to them. I’m dedicated to providing compassionate and individualized care by providing patient education and practicing evidence-based medicine. I’m passionate about practicing preventive medicine and helping my patients manage acute and chronic health conditions, mental health.

I find joy by doing almost any outdoor activity, including hiking, running, and exploring with our furbabies. I enjoy spending time with family and friends. I also strive to live mindfully and intentionally by creating uplifting routines and relaxing rituals.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the typical process of recovery?

The European languages are members of the same family. Their separate existence is a myth. For science, music, sport, etc, Europe uses the same vocabulary. The languages only differ in their grammar, their pronunciation and their most common words. Everyone realizes why a new common language would be desirable.

How much will a survivor recover from a severe brain injury?

The new common language will be more simple and regular than the existing European languages. It will be as simple as Occidental; in fact, it will be Occidental. To an English person, it will seem like simplified English, as a skeptical Cambridge friend of mine told me what Occidental is. The European languages are members.

 

How does rehabilitation (recovery) influence outcome?

To an English person, it will seem like simplified English. Their separate existence is a myth. The new common language will be more simple and regular than the existing European languages. It will be as simple as Occidental; in fact, it will be Occidental. To an English person, it will seem like simplified English, as a skeptical Cambridge friend of mine told me what Occidental is. The European languages are members of the same family. 

What does rehabilitation involve?

The new common language will be more simple and regular than the existing European languages. It will be as simple as Occidental; in fact, it will be Occidental. To an English person, it will seem like simplified English, as a skeptical Cambridge friend of mine told me what Occidental is. The European languages are members of the same family. Their separate existence is a myth.

What happens after rehabilitation ends?

To an English person, it will seem like simplified English, as a skeptical Cambridge friend of mine told me what Occidental is. The European languages are members of the same family. Their separate existence is a myth.

item.title: Amputee Rehabilitation
item.dc:creator: cmsmasters
item.content:encoded:
About Amputee Rehabilitation Services

I enjoy getting to know my patients and building meaningful relationships. I understand that each person is unique and that they have diverse cultural backgrounds, so I strive to actively listen and empower them to be an advocate for the health and wellness goals that are important to them. I’m dedicated to providing compassionate and individualized care by providing patient education and practicing evidence-based medicine. I’m passionate about practicing preventive medicine and helping my patients manage acute and chronic health conditions, mental health.

I find joy by doing almost any outdoor activity, including hiking, running, and exploring with our furbabies. I enjoy spending time with family and friends. I also strive to live mindfully and intentionally by creating uplifting routines and relaxing rituals.
